sourceInventory.source: NASA MODIS MCD43A4.061 NBAR via Microsoft Planetary Computer

qualityCodes.2: all contributing pixels full BRDF inversion

sourceInventory.sampling: Fixed dates; complete 16-day acquisition windows strictly within 2026 Q2; RGB bands 1,4,3
sourceInventory.compositing: Per-date native QA filtering then linear 2x2 mean (any magnitude contribution marks lower QA); temporal median prefers full-QA 1km dates, otherwise magnitude-QA dates; no color adjustments

credit: NASA MODIS Terra+Aqua MCD43A4 Collection 6.1; Microsoft Planetary Computer mirror
fallback: NASA Blue Marble Next Generation July 2004 for water and unavailable observations
grid: EPSG:4326, 1/120 degree, about 928 m at equator
displayCurve: Linear reflectance encoded with standard sRGB OETF; no gain, saturation, highlight stretch or per-region colour correction
resampling: QA-filtered native 500m reflectance reduced to 1km; bilinear geographic reprojection; base averaged in linear space
oceanTreatment: Existing atlas land/lake mask; legacy water and missing observations with narrow edge blend
landAreaFractionDefinition: Area-weighted fraction of terrestrial coverage, using atlas land fraction and cos(latitude); includes interior gap feather. Coastal ocean blend is already represented by the land fraction and is not counted a second time.
